messages:
maria: hi team :wave: I'm on my first week and trying to run the onboarding CI but the Buildkite pipeline is failing early. Job shows 'permission denied' pulling image and GH Actions workflows complain 'Missing required secret: DOCKERHUB_TOKEN'. Who should I ping for permissions?
kevin: welcome! :tada: first check: did you accept the Buildkite invite and join the infra team on GitHub? a lot of perms stem from that.
maria: I accepted the BK invite and I can see the pipeline, but job logs show: 'docker pull registry.redwood-inference.internal/repo:latest: unauthorized: authentication required'
sam: that usually means the runner/agent doesn't have credentials. For GitHub Actions, secrets are org/repo-scoped. If your account isn't in the right team the workflow can't access org secrets. pinging @devops for org app access.
devops-bot: FYI: If your org uses SAML/SSO, ensure you're provisioned into the 'infra-ci' team. Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/ci-setup
kevin: also check GitHub Apps: our app 'redwood-ci' needs Actions permission. Go to Settings -> Applications -> Authorized GitHub Apps and confirm it's authorized for your account.
maria: I don't see 'redwood-ci' in my authorized apps list.
sam: that'll block a lot. I can trigger a reauth and add you to infra-ci. @kevin can you grant maria access to infra-ci and reauthorize the app for her?
kevin: done — added maria to infra-ci, reauthorized redwood-ci for her account, and re-added her to the Buildkite team 'eng-infra'.
buildkite-bot: Buildkite: invite accepted by maria
maria: re-running the pipeline now...
maria: Buildkite moved forward but now failing at the docker build step: 'failed to fetch cache manifest: access denied to blob'
sam: that's ECR permission related. Are you logged in via AWS SSO locally? Try: `aws sso login --profile redwood-dev` then `aws ecr get-login-password --profile redwood-dev | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin <ecr-uri>`
maria: I ran that locally and I can pull, but CI still fails.
devops-bot: Note: Buildkite agents pull from a separate ECR repo and use the CI deployment role. If you need push/pull on a feature branch for debugging, request temporary branch permissions. File a ticket in #help with branch name.
ci-engineer: I just granted the build role permission for branch 'feature/onboarding-ci-fix' for 2 hours. Try re-run.
maria: reran — Buildkite completed the build and integration-tests step started. GH Actions still flagged the missing DOCKERHUB_TOKEN secret on a dependent repo.
kevin: heads up: we tightened secrets scoping recently and moved DOCKERHUB_TOKEN to the 'platform' repo only. Repo-level workflows won't see org secrets anymore unless explicitly allowed. Which workflow is failing?
maria: 'deploy-wheels.yml' in tooling repo.
sam: on it — I'll add DOCKERHUB_TOKEN to that repo's Actions secrets (scoped to this workflow).
sam: added secret and allowed it for workflows from the tooling repo.
maria: pipeline and GH Actions are green now :tada: thank you all. A couple quick notes for the onboarding docs: checklist items to add — accept Buildkite invite, authorize 'redwood-ci' GitHub App, confirm membership in infra-ci team, run `aws sso login` locally, and request ECR branch permissions if needed.
kevin: great suggestion — filing a docs issue: https://redwood.internal/docs/issues/987
maria: closing thread, thanks again. ping me if you want me to expand the checklist into the onboarding playbook.
